SERVICES AGREEMENT
This Services Agreement is made between Kedai Contoh Sdn Bhd ("Customer") and Awan Biru Pte Ltd ("Vendor").
1. Services
1.1 The Vendor shall provide cloud bookkeeping services described in Schedule A.
1.2 The Vendor shall perform the services with reasonable skill and care.

5. Liability
5.1 The Customer shall be liable without limit for any loss suffered by the Vendor.
5.2 The Vendor's total liability is limited to the fees paid in the one month before the claim.
6. Renewal
6.1 This Agreement renews automatically for successive 12 month terms unless the Customer gives 90 days written notice.

9. Governing law
9.1 This Agreement is governed by the laws of the State of Delaware.
10. General
10.1 Notices must be sent by registered post.
